description: A four-panel composite figure of engineering force-stroke curves comparing hot-compression finite-element simulations (Model1, Model2) with experimental data under varying (two-stage) deformation conditions. Every panel shares x-axis Stroke (mm), 0 to ~5, and y-axis Force (N); the legend in each is identical: solid line = Experimental, star markers = Model1, open-circle markers = Model2. (a) and (b) carry the header Temperature: 950°C and plot two strain-rate paths, 0.01s⁻¹-0.1s⁻¹ (blue) and 0.1s⁻¹-0.01s⁻¹ (magenta), at 0.2 strain (a) and 0.4 strain (b); y-axis 0-10000 N. (c) and (d) carry the header Strain rate: 0.01s⁻¹ and plot two temperature paths, 1050°C-950°C and 950°C-1050°C, at 0.2 strain (c) and 0.4 strain (d); y-axis 0-6000 N. All curves rise steeply, then at the path change (stroke ~1.7-1.8 mm in (a), ~2.9-3.0 mm in (b)-(d)) either continue or drop sharply before rising again; in the second stage the star-marked Model1 traces deviate most from the experimental line, whereas the open-circle Model2 traces follow it more closely, especially for the strain-rate-decrease and temperature-rise paths.

observations.observation: The figure contains four force-stroke panels, each with identical axes (Force (N) vs Stroke (mm)) and identical legend: solid line = Experimental, star markers = Model1, open-circle markers = Model2.
Panel (a) is headed 'Temperature: 950°C' and plots two labelled conditions, '0.01s⁻¹-0.1s⁻¹(0.2 strain)' (blue) and '0.1s⁻¹-0.01s⁻¹(0.2 strain)' (magenta), with y-axis Force (N) spanning 0-10000.
Panel (b) is headed 'Temperature: 950°C' and plots '0.01s⁻¹-0.1s⁻¹(0.4 strain)' and '0.1s⁻¹-0.01s⁻¹(0.4 strain)', y-axis Force (N) 0-10000.
Panels (c) and (d) are headed 'Strain rate: 0.01s⁻¹' and plot temperature-path conditions '1050°C-950°C' and '950°C-1050°C', with y-axis Force (N) spanning 0-6000.
Panel (c) labels the curves '1050°C-950°C(0.2 strain)' (blue) and '950°C-1050°C(0.2 strain)' (magenta); panel (d) labels them with the same two temperature paths but at (0.4 strain).

In every panel the force rises through a first stage, and at a stroke of roughly 1.7-1.8 mm (a) or ~2.9-3.0 mm (b, d) the curve of the strain-rate/temperature change condition drops sharply before rising again in the second stage.
The star-marked Model1 traces deviate more strongly from the solid Experimental line in the second stage than the open-circle Model2 traces.
The caption states panels (a) and (b) are at T=950°C with strain-rate paths ε̇=0.01 or 0.1 s⁻¹, and (c) and (d) are at ε̇=0.01 s⁻¹ with temperature paths T=1050 or 950°C.
The caption text describing the (a)/(b) strain-rate and (c)/(d) temperature sub-labels is OCR-garbled and does not read cleanly against the panel legends.
The citing text states that the finite element simulation of hot compression under varying deformation conditions was compared with experimental results in Fig. 10.
The citing text states Model1's second-stage force significantly exceeded the experimental curves, while Model2 better captured force evolution under varying deformation conditions.
The citing text attributes Model1's error to a delayed forecast of the flow-stress drop after an abrupt decrease in strain rate or a temperature rise (Fig. 8c and 9c).

subfigures.description: Force-stroke plot at Temperature: 950°C, y-axis Force (N) 0-10000, x-axis Stroke (mm) 0-5+. Two conditions: blue 0.01s⁻¹-0.1s⁻¹(0.2 strain) rising monotonically, magenta 0.1s⁻¹-0.01s⁻¹(0.2 strain) which dips at ~1.7 mm then rises again. Legend: Experimental (solid), Model1 (stars), Model2 (open circles); Model1 stars diverge from the solid experimental line more than Model2.

Force-stroke plot at Temperature: 950°C for 0.4 strain, y 0-10000 N, x 0-5 mm. Curves labelled 0.01s⁻¹-0.1s⁻¹(0.4 strain) (blue) and 0.1s⁻¹-0.01s⁻¹(0.4 strain) (magenta); the strain-rate drop path falls sharply near stroke ~2.9 mm before recovering. Same three-entry legend (Experimental / Model1 stars / Model2 open circles).

Force-stroke plot at Strain rate: 0.01s⁻¹, y 0-6000 N, x 0-5 mm. Conditions 1050°C-950°C(0.2 strain) (blue) and 950°C-1050°C(0.2 strain) (magenta); the temperature-rise path drops at ~2.4 mm then rises. Legend as in other panels.

Force-stroke plot at Strain rate: 0.01s⁻¹ for 0.4 strain, y 0-6000 N, x 0-5 mm. Conditions 1050°C-950°C(0.4 strain) (blue) and 950°C-1050°C(0.4 strain) (magenta); a sharp drop occurs at ~3.0 mm for both paths. Legend as in other panels.
